fixesApplied.summary: Converted recent user activity from simple TTL eviction to stale-while-revalidate verified route cache.
fixesApplied.before: After the in-memory TTL elapsed, the next request blocked on transactions and task events before returning a useful activity payload.
fixesApplied.after: A validated activity payload stays displayable beyond the ideal freshness window while an async refresh replaces it only after verification.

residualRisks.risk: The overview route still performs a username-enrichment pass after the first parallel read group. Existing safe diagnostic wrappers prevent one optional source from throwing the whole route, and admin data remains private no-store.
residualRisks.followUp: Only split overview into smaller route segments if measured Admin Overview first-useful render becomes launch-blocking.

residualRisks.risk: Chat has no persisted client hot-cache for a first visit on a new device. It preserves state during background refresh, but the first thread list still depends on the authenticated API.
residualRisks.followUp: Do not add browser persistence for private chat without a separate security review.
